properties.name: A write and an approval record the agent they went through beside the person they were for: the ACTS_FOR rung, deferred since 2026-07-22, is built
properties.rationale: THE CAUSE (live design: fact:root-cause-an-agent-deciding-for-its-principal-has-no-record-because-the-acts-for-rung-was-deferred-2026-09-29, and fact:root-cause-the-auth-enum-already-says-upstream-signed-over-mtls-and-what-is-missing-is-delegated-identity-2026-09-29; both are in the live design, not in this export). The rung dec:design-authorship-identity named on 2026-07-22 (git author/committer split) was deferred and nothing re-asked it; every write through flo2 by an agent then recorded the person and not the agent, and a separate owner agent deciding under a delegation could be recorded only as the signed-in person. FIXED AT THE CAUSE: the rung is built, stamped at ONE place (the store edge write, via acting.rs::stamp_through_acting_agent, and authored_by for the role it writes), so the typed helper, every settle path, create_edge, create_edges and draw_edges (#629) are all covered and no write site can forget it. ACCEPTED requirement: req:a-write-and-an-approval-record-the-agent-and-the-person-it-acts-for (Anthony, 2026-09-29, live design). CHOICES AND WHY THE OTHERS LOST (dec:idea-an-agent-acting-for-a-person-is-recorded-as-both): (a) nothing: loses the agent on every hosted write. (b) an ACTS_FOR edge alone: says an agent acts for a person, never WHICH act it carried. (d) a field on AUTHORED_BY alone: the property-nobody-reads risk, and no standing relation to query. TAKEN: (b) plus a per-role *_via set on AUTHORED_BY, read by loop_status. (c), the delegation record, stays open (dec:idea-a-standing-delegation-to-an-agent-is-a-record-with-an-escalation-boundary). FOR flo2 AT ITS MOVE TO THIS RELEASE: pass the calling agent the way it passes the person, as the request _meta key reflow2/acting_agent whose value is the Contributor id of an automated_agent in that design (the gateway must first ensure that Contributor exists; reflow2 refuses an unknown or person-kind agent and writes nothing); flo2 cap:the-gateway-passes-the-calling-agent-to-the-engine. PINNED: a_write_records_the_agent_beside_the_principal (every settle path the tools declare, through the real request path) failed 6 of 7 on a clean origin/main build (db305d4) under the shared build lock and passes 7 of 7 here, also after merging #629, #630 and #631; a_write_records_the_agent_it_went_through pins the core (8 of 8).
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: A session (writes_for acting_agent), a request (_meta reflow2/acting_agent) or the client handshake name (matched to an automated_agent Contributor handle, never minted) names the AGENT a write goes through. Every AUTHORED_BY role recorded meanwhile carries it in authored_via / reviewed_via / approved_via, stamped at the store edge write, and the agent is drawn ACTS_FOR the person (new edge type, route). Attribution only. loop_status assigned decisions say acted_through or "no agent known".
